verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a public RESTful API for programmatically managing resources. It has a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec at api.paperspace.com/v1/openapi.json covering 61 paths, a generated per-endpoint reference with cURL examples, and team-scoped API keys that also cover a JavaScript SDK and CLI. Machine creation is explicitly documented as possible via the API. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API, and an interactive in-page request runner in the reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Programmatically manage Paperspace resources using conventional HTTP requests.
The production API domain serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at /v1/openapi.json
API keys let you interact with Paperspace through the Core RESTful API, the Core JavaScript SDK, and Gradient command-line utility (CLI).
You can create a Linux machine using the Paperspace console, Paperspace API, or Paperspace CLI.
